name: Resolve pose using reference views
when: Several positions or yaw orientations could explain one reference projection.
procedure: Relate the supplied reference views using their available camera information.
Compare object position, scale in projection, occlusion and distinctive features across those views.
Choose a pose that explains the available references jointly, preserving fixed asset size and task-permitted rotation.
verification: A pose improvement in one view does not create an unexplained mismatch in another.
failure_lessons: With a single reference view, preserve uncertainty rather than inventing hidden target views.
adaptation_notes: Adapts Multi-view Verification & Occlusion for pose estimation without external reconstruction tools.
